stage2_results.intake-1367: DIVE-VERIFIED against arXiv:2605.26200v1. Central conclusion (worth_investigating as an audit rubric) STANDS and no claim is overturned: the 21-system audit is rubric-based with an inspectable per-system trace and the 81.0/71.4/90.5% rates re-derive exactly, but single-coder, no inter-rater reliability, public artifacts only, and section 8 states the rates are NOT prevalence estimates; ">100 papers" is asserted, never enumerated; the six remedies carry zero implementation and zero evaluation. The framework is partly definitional, and the papers factual load is carried by three other groups measurements, none of them in our index. Net value: a vocabulary ("autonomous execution under non-autonomous epistemic control"), one operational test ("adding an external checker is insufficient if its output does not gate the loop" - the same finding as our computed-guard-never-consulted family, reached from the opposite direction), and a scorecard whose worst cell is autopilot L2, where planner AND critic are roles served by the fleet under optimization.
